purpose: Rights register for the clean-room AIAssistent1 assistant SFT v11 dataset.

review.decision_evidence: Direct rights-holder authorization in the Codex task on 2026-09-05 confirms that V11 belongs to the project, contains no real personal data, and is permitted for model training and derivative-weight distribution. V11 was authored manually; the dataset generator was not run. prepare_dataset.py only assembled approved sources into the exact V11 artifacts.
